title: Residence Shares for Transfer Students in the UIL Travel Fee Schedule, Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
**Residence share of the travel fee.** For a UIL Academic and Robotics Team participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, a residence share of the travel fee of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** applies by the student's district enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year, kept by Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions: 125 percent for a Non-Resident Transfer, 80 percent for an Intra-District Transfer (Employee Child), and 100 percent otherwise.

| Enrollment type on the record in status enrolled for the school year | Residence share |
|---|---|
| Non-Resident Transfer | 125 percent |
| Intra-District Transfer (Employee Child) | 80 percent |
| Attendance Zone Enrollment or any other type | 100 percent |
| no such record | 100 percent |

*Illustration (hypothetical amount).* On a hypothetical 64.00, the shares give 80.00 at 125 percent, 51.20 at 80 percent and 64.00 at 100 percent.
